answer: Like a pearl hidden in a harbor, one permit ties one agent to one car. One agent buys a residential parking permit and links the plate number to a single identity, so a flood of fakes has to pass a crystal gate of paperwork: three established peers check the number in the municipal registry, the vehicle registration, and a fresh signature. A permit costs $15 to $50 a year plus the vehicle itself, so a thousand fakes burns $15,000 to $50,000 and a thousand cars, each one waiting on a separate office visit. Permits renew yearly, so a fake dies when its paperwork lapses; no haven hides it.
